comparison.objective: Route a flexible cable through posts while preserving one clip and seating another; candidate tunes and locks a rigid damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable routing, slack management, and clip insertion versus precision rotary adjustment and recessed fastener tool use.
comparison.success_condition: Correct cable path, both clips seated, retained joints, and released stable wire; candidate instead evaluates impact energy, stroke, force, rebound, and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual coordination is generic; deformable routing and clip seating test a different ability.
